component.name: Sysmon
component.summary: Live system monitor for CPU, battery, memory, network, and processes

description.p: Sysmon is a lightweight desktop system monitor built with GTK4 and libadwaita. It shows live readouts of CPU load and frequency, package and core power draw (RAPL), CPU temperature, battery health and wattage, memory usage, network throughput, and a sortable apps/processes table. Hardware is auto-discovered so it runs on arbitrary Linux machines.
